title.en: A food program and a dataset receive nothing from a home

goal.en: Two recipient roles have empty allow-lists: program (a food bank or a school) and dataset. Derive both over the example household and see twelve withheld facets and zero constraints, which is the intended result.

note.en: A program plans menus from its own Distribution documents and the recipes' allergen lists; it receives nothing from households.
A dataset receives nothing either: there is no research export of household facets, derived or raw.
Every withheld entry carries the reason, so an auditor can tell an empty allow-list from a missing consent.

outcome.en: A refusal is a result: a program that integrates with homes gets an empty list by design and keeps working from its own documents. Next: 085, what another robot in the same home may learn.
